biggest_catch: Trymata's official FAQ confirms daily PayPal payouts after test acceptance - but publishes no worker pay figures at all, so there is no concrete official pay to verify.
catches: No official pay figures: all dollar-per-test claims ($5-$30) come from third parties, not Trymata.
Tests are only paid after acceptance by Trymata's review team - rejected tests earn nothing.
No guaranteed test volume; tests are matched to your profile and first-come, first-served.
A practice/qualification test is required before paid tests unlock.
The platform merged with QuestionPro in 2026 (reported) - tester signup now runs on the QuestionPro UX domain, so payment details may change.

c1.evidence: Trymata's official FAQ publishes no worker pay figures - only third-party sources quote per-test amounts.

c2.evidence: trymata.com official FAQ: 'We send out payments every day, in the morning US Pacific Time... We send you payment via Paypal after your test is accepted.'

c3.evidence: Free to join as a tester; no upfront fee.

c4.evidence: Official timing exists but no official concrete worker pay figures - fails the concrete-pay requirement.

eligibility: Sign up on Trymata, complete qualification questions and a practice test, have a computer/smartphone with microphone and internet, hold a PayPal account.
maximize: Trymata is rejected here because its official FAQ publishes no worker pay figures - treat third-party dollar-per-test claims as unverified. Its official daily PayPal payouts are documented; if official rates ever appear, prioritize longer moderated sessions and keep feedback detailed to pass the review team that gates every payment.
notes: Trymata's official tester FAQ (trymata.com) confirms daily morning-Pacific PayPal payouts after test acceptance, but states no worker pay figures. All per-test dollar amounts in circulation are third-party claims.

steps: Sign up on Trymata and complete the qualification questions and practice test.
Claim tests matched to your profile; record your screen and voice while completing scenarios.
Submit for review; accepted tests are paid via PayPal in the daily morning-Pacific payout.
timing: Official: payments sent every day in the morning US Pacific Time via PayPal, after test acceptance by the review team.
